choice: Restricted attachment list and detail reads to users with view permission on the attached model, because any authenticated user could previously read every attachment.
final:
I changed the attachment API so that reading attachments now requires view permission on the model each attachment belongs to. Before, any logged-in user could list or fetch every attachment, whatever their role permissions on the linked model. The 52 tests you listed pass, but I didn't add a test for the new behaviour.

The change is in `AttachmentMixin.get_queryset` in `common/api.py`. Read requests (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS) exclude attachments whose model type the user can't view. Create, update and delete requests keep their existing explicit permission checks. I left those alone because the existing tests expect a 403 for a denied write, and filtering the queryset would have turned that into a 404.

CHOICE: Restricted attachment list and detail reads to users with view permission on the attached model, because any authenticated user could previously read every attachment.
